conbody.p: With the vehicle on, select SetupVehicleDriver assistanceParking safetyRear cross-traffic safety on the infotainment system screen to turn on Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist.

note.p: When the vehicle is restarted, Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist will automatically turn on. You can deactivate the function in the settings menu, but in that case, you will not be able to receive Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist from the system. Always drive with caution.

When the vehicle and the trailer are connected electrically, Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist will always turn on. However, if is deselected after the vehicle is restarted, the driver should always be aware of the surroundings and drive safely.

When the trailer connector is connected, Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist automatically turns off. In this case, you cannot get help from Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist. Always drive with care. (if Kia genuine part equipped)
